main.description: Lets readers ask the author public questions (pub.leaflet.interactions.question) and shows the ones the author has answered (pub.leaflet.interactions.answer). Questions are resolved at render time rather than stored on the block.

buttonText.description: Label for the button readers use to submit a question.

audience.description: Who may ask: anyone, only accounts the author follows, or only accounts following the author. Defaults to anyone. Checked when a question is asked.
